objective: Build Egg Garden's Blender art: seven unique eggs, a shell fragment and the Splash Dash mini-game kit, committed with a generated nil-id GardenAssets module and an upload workflow that covers night, spire and garden.
inputs: origin/garden/v2 docs/architecture/garden.md section 9 (model names, sizes, placement)
acceptance_criteria: 15 assets exist as Blender scripts, FBX and PNG in assets/garden/, with manifest entries; build/blender/garden/contact_sheet.png and eggs_lineup.png are reviewed
Every egg is 800-2.5k tris, egg_shell_fragment under 200, Splash Dash pieces 500-3k and dash_island up to 5k (manifest tris), with no decimation
Names, sizes and mesh counts match docs/architecture/garden.md section 9; GardenAssets.spec.luau proves them
Moving models are one mesh with the bounding box centre where section 9 expects it, because pivots are not kept on import
Fronts sit on Blender -Y so they reach Roblox -Z at yaw 0, per the Studio measurement in NIGHT-010
src/shared/GardenAssets.luau is generated with nil ids; GardenAssets.spec.luau proves it matches the manifest
The upload workflow offers night, spire and garden, and regenerating NightAssets.luau through the moved script changes only its header line
Register rows read Pending upload until the Director runs the upload; no other game code changes
verification: lune run tests/run, selene src tests, stylua --check, node tools/validate-tasks.mjs, node tools/check-scope.mjs origin/main; QA reviews the contact sheet and lineup; after the upload, a Studio check of facing, scale and the Neon glow meshes
notes: Numbered 020 to stay clear of the designer's GARDEN tasks. upload-assets.mjs and write-assets-module.mjs moved to tools/blender/ exactly as on origin/game5/spire, so that branch merges without a conflict. src/relay/Models.luau line 158 and the NightAssets.luau header still name the old script path; left alone because this task changes no game code. Upload is run by the Director after merge. The designer's architecture section 9 overrides the first brief where they differ, on the coordinator's instruction: sweeper 40 long, ball 10, pendulum 30 tall, platform 12 x 2, ready pad 12 wide and low, island 300 x 160 (the brief said 24, 12, a hammer on a beam, 16, 14 with a sign post, 80 x 80).
